0.7.6 is a drop-in patch for 0.7.0, 0.7.1, 0.7.2, 0.7.3, 0.7.4 and 0.7.5: format epoch 3 is unchanged, with no storage, snapshot, WAL or Raft protocol change. Upgrade in place with an ordinary rolling restart (`helm upgrade`). No fresh install or data move is needed.

- **Check the gateway's memory before the upgrade.** The gateway now bounds the request bodies it buffers at once with a body budget, 256 MiB by default. If you raised `--max-request-body-bytes` (`gateway.maxRequestBodyBytes`), an unset budget grows to that limit plus the 32 MiB small-body headroom, so set `--body-budget-bytes` (`gateway.bodyBudgetBytes`) to at least that grown value and give the gateway about twice its budget in memory. A budget set below the limit plus 32 MiB makes the gateway exit at startup, and the chart refuses it. A gateway before 0.7.6 exits on the new flags, so unset `gateway.bodyBudgetBytes` and remove them from `gateway.extraArgs` before a rollback. From 0.7.0, a values file that pins `global.image.tag` or `gateway.image.tag` must move it together with the chart, as for 0.7.1, and from 0.7.4 or earlier the 0.7.5 upgrade notes apply too.
- **The gateway answers three new refusals**, each marked as one that applied nothing: `503` `UploadBudgetExhausted` with `Retry-After: 1` when the budget stays spent for `--body-budget-wait-ms` (1000 by default), `408` `RequestBodyTooSlow` when no byte of a body arrives for `--body-stall-timeout` (30 s by default) or less than `--body-min-bytes-per-sec` (1 KiB/s by default) arrives over one such window, and `429` `TenantUploads` or `TenantUploadBytes` with `Retry-After: 1` for the per-bucket limits below. A slow upload that keeps arriving is never cut. The SQLite extension takes each as a refusal that applied nothing, and 0.7.6 changes neither the extension nor `@tonbo/sqlite-ursula`.
- **A quota policy can bound each bucket's uploads** with `max_concurrent_uploads` and `max_upload_bytes`, under `[default]` or a `[[bucket]]` of `--quota-policy`. They count the bucket's bodies over `--small-body-max-bytes` (1 MiB by default) while the gateway reads them. A policy that sets neither, and a gateway without access control or a quota policy, answer no new `429`.
- **New gateway metrics** at `/__ursula/gateway/metrics`: `upload_refusals_budget`, `upload_refusals_tenant_uploads`, `upload_refusals_tenant_bytes`, `upload_refusals_too_slow`, `upload_budget_bytes`, `upload_reserved_bytes`, `upload_tenants`, `body_bytes_buffered` and `refusal_drain_bytes`.
- **Rust library APIs changed** in `ursula-gateway` (`GatewayConfig::uploads` with `uploads::UploadLimits`, `admission::TenantLimits`, `AdmissionRejection`, `Admission::admit_upload` and `UploadGuard`), with no wire or on-disk change.

Known issues: [#411](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/411), [#452](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/452), [#461](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/461), [#465](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/465), [#484](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/484), [#490](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/490), [#492](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/492), [#494](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/494), [#496](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/496), [#497](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/497), [#517](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/517), [#518](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/518), [#539](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/539), [#550](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/550), [#561](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/561) and [#566](https://github.com/tonbo-io/ursula/issues/566). Every change is listed in the [0.7.6 release notes](https://ursula.tonbo.io/docs/release-notes#076).
